steps.note: Buffalo whey with a little whey starter from mozzarella is heated to about 90 °C, where its albumins flocculate.
Salt, 2 kg per 100 litres of whey, goes into the kettle.
The ricotta is taken off as it floats and filled into baskets.
It drains 4–5 hours in a cold room.
The forms are salted a second time by sprinkling, on wooden boards in the cold room.
It ripens on wooden boards in a cold room or a dry, cold cellar, 120 days for the buffalo ricotta and 30–90 days given for sheep's.

links.name: Ricotta di bufala (salata, infornata, affumicata), PAT Lazio, in the Atlante dei prodotti tipici (ONAF)

sources.text: The steps and the 120 days of a Lazio buffalo-whey ricotta salata from the regional list of traditional products, and the 30–90 days and the pressing of the usual sheep's-whey ricotta salata from the second page; the two differ in whether it is pressed.
